title: Five Elements / 五行 / Пять стихий
sources: Classical Wu Xing generating (相生) and controlling (相剋) cycles; universal across all consulted sources.

seasonByMonthBranch.note: Element that commands the season (当令) for each solar month branch. Chen/Xu/Chou/Wei are the earth transition months.

seasonalPhase.note: 旺相休囚死 classification is classical. The numeric multipliers are an INFERRED modelling choice of this implementation; they are declared here so they can be audited and changed without touching code.
seasonalPhase.rule: wang = element equal to season element; xiang = element generated BY season element; xiu = element that generates the season element; qiu = element that controls the season element; si = element controlled by the season element.
